summary: New acceptance_matrix (6 criteria) covering the username system: required/validated username field at registration, live-availability UI state, profile username-change section, legacy-account non-blocking reminder, and identity-preserving rename. Per seed_facts/spec_deviations, SQL 012 (docs/migrations/012_username_system.sql) has NOT been applied to the real Lovable-managed Supabase project, so the username_available/set_my_username RPCs genuinely don't exist there yet. Client-side validation (UsernameField/lib/username.ts) and the SQL-012 fallback hint were verified against the REAL backend (one run through the public preview ingress, as required). Everything that needs the RPCs to actually succeed (live availability result, real save) was verified with an in-browser Supabase mock (fake JWT session + page.route interception), mirroring the already-proven pattern from prior iterations, since no real test accounts/migration exist to exercise end-to-end. All 5 browser checks passed on first attempt; existing backend pytest suite (5 tests, unrelated to this matrix) re-run clean and untouched.

checks.criterion: Registrierung zeigt ein Pflichtfeld für den Benutzernamen
checks.name: auth-register-username-required-validation
checks.evidence: Real app (no mocking needed - pure client-side validation). Switching to Registrieren shows data-testid=auth-username-input. Submitting with empty username shows 'Bitte wähle einen Benutzernamen.' and stays on the register form (no navigation to /karte, no account created).

checks.name: auth-register-username-required-validation
checks.evidence: Same check: 'ab' (2 chars) and 'bad name!' (invalid char/space) both show the USERNAME_HINT text '3–20 Zeichen: Buchstaben, Zahlen und Unterstriche.'; a 25-char input is clamped to <=20 chars by the field's onChange handler (maxLength enforced client-side).

checks.criterion: Verfügbarkeit wird während der Eingabe angezeigt
checks.name: auth-username-availability-sql012-hint-public-preview
checks.evidence: Run against the public preview ingress (https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com), real Supabase, no mocking. Typing a valid-format username ('TscheckValidName1') triggers the username_available RPC call, which 404s (RPC missing pre-SQL-012); UI shows EXACTLY 'Prüfung momentan nicht möglich. SQL 012 muss zuerst ausgeführt werden.' and never 'Verfügbar ✓' or 'Bereits vergeben'. Matches spec_deviations (blocked externally, not a frontend bug).

checks.name: profile-username-settings-section-visible
checks.evidence: Mocked authenticated session (profile_cards -> username='tscheckmain'). /profil shows data-testid=profile-username-settings with profile-username-input prefilled 'tscheckmain' and data-testid=profile-username-save-button visible.

checks.criterion: Bestehende Konten ohne Benutzernamen bleiben nutzbar
checks.name: legacy-account-username-reminder-not-locked-out
checks.evidence: Mocked session with profile_cards -> username=null (legacy account, needsUsername=true). /karte renders normally with app-bottom-nav visible (not locked out) and data-testid=username-reminder shown with username-reminder-link href=/profil; clicking the link navigates to /profil and shows profile-username-settings so the name can be set later.

checks.name: profile-username-save-uses-existing-identity
checks.evidence: Mocked session (xp=350, featured_badges=[b1,b2], username='tscheckold'). Saving a new name called set_my_username with body EXACTLY {_username:'tscheckNewName'} (no client-sent id/user_id field - captured and asserted via intercepted POST body, confirming the RPC relies solely on the session JWT's auth.uid()). Success toast 'Benutzername gespeichert' shown; after invalidation/refetch, profile-username-input updated to the new name while XP (350) stayed visible/unchanged, i.e. friends/XP/badges tied to the same identity were not reset.

notes: 6 acceptance_matrix criteria covered by 5 checks[] entries (criteria 1 and 2 are both exercised by the single auth-register-username-required-validation check, since both concern the same registration form's client-side validation and have no independent UI surface).

No new backend pytest files: this matrix has no FastAPI surface (it's entirely Supabase-RPC/UI-driven per spec_deviations); the existing backend suite (community chat migration + health, 5 tests) was re-run and remains green/unaffected.

Per spec_deviations, live availability checks and real persisted renames against the actual Supabase project are blocked until SQL 012 is run manually in Lovable - this is an external prerequisite, not a frontend defect. The SQL-012 fallback hint was verified for real (criterion 3, via the public ingress); the actually-successful RPC paths (criteria 5 and 6's full save flow) were verified via an in-browser Supabase mock, the same proven pattern used in prior iterations given no real test accounts exist.
No bugs found; all 5 checks passed on the first run (no reruns/flakiness needed).
